## SOS Intake & AI Triage

nginx proxies `POST /api/sos` on port 80 to this webhook, so the portal is same-origin and no node IP is baked into the HTML.

**A request is never lost.** If Ollama is down, slow, or returns garbage, the row is still written — flagged `needs_review` with severity defaulted to Critical.

**Nothing in this workflow may throw.** An n8n execution error returns HTTP 200 with an empty body, which the portal would read as success. Partial submissions are therefore stored and flagged, never rejected; only a wholly empty POST gets a 400.

Model: edit `DEFAULT_MODEL` in Normalize Intake. `install.sh` reads it from this file and pulls that model.

nodes.name: Has Any Content?
nodes.notes: Only a completely empty POST is turned away — a probe or a bot on the open SSID.

nodes.name: Ollama Triage
nodes.notes: Internal Docker DNS only; Ollama is never published to the host. Errors fall through to Validate Triage, which flags the row for review.

nodes.name: Store Request
nodes.notes: Writes to the `triage` database, not n8n's own.

nodes.name: Respond to Portal
nodes.notes: The portal treats a missing status:received as failure, so this is the only path that reports success. Severity is deliberately not returned: the portal must neither reassure nor alarm.
